rules.scope: pure additions with a newly added if condition; other repairs are out of scope
rules.targets: bound array indices, null-checked dereferences, integer calculations with a native memory-consumer value path, explicit memory length operands
rules.control: native CDG path through conditions only plus native CFG dominance; no forward sibling expansion
rules.data: backward native REACHING_DEF, exact bound operand and actual write required
rules.alignment: identical atomic statement, corresponding parameter/declaration bindings and unchanged control context
rules.budget: complete target/control/data paths, ordered by uncertainty and path length; never partial paths
rules.unknown: unresolved binding, alias, macro, call effect, ambiguous correspondence or missing native evidence
rules.checked_values: array-element predicates and opaque call results stay unknown; their address indices/arguments are not the checked values

cohort: all eight historical addition pairs plus 16 Seed42 sampled AST-added-if pairs; no outcome filtering
review: all executable vulnerable-side lines in union of historical, mapped-control and targeted outputs
